originalSourceText:
Q.7    Probabilistic models are particularly useful in robotics because they:

      (A) Eliminate uncertainty.

      (B) Ignore sensor measurements.

      (C) Model sensor noise and real-world uncertainty.

      (D) Always produce the shortest path.

       Explanation: (C)

      Refer Slide: 12 of Lecture: 4
